title: WebGPU Stencil Buffer Outlines with Rust and wgpu
description: Render toon-shaded stencil buffer outlines with Rust, wgpu, and WebGPU. Learn two-draw masking, mesh expansion, depth-stencil state, and WGSL.
imageAlt: Red toon-shaded Venus statue surrounded by a white stencil buffer outline on a dark WebGPU canvas.
